lines.text: Can you, not do you can!
Many learners say: Do you can help me?
Can you! Can you help me?

native.hook: 问句里 can 前面不加 do！
native.tip: 中文说“你能帮我吗”，没有多余的词。英语里 can 自己就能提问，直接放到句首，不用再加 do。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Do you can help me?”😅 can 提问时不加 do，直接放句首：“Can you help me?”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“Can you help me?”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: In English, can makes a question by itself, so do not add do.
en.caption: Do you say “Do you can help me?” 😅 Can makes a question by itself, so do not add do: “Can you help me?” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
